intro: Dig Rat Stew is a culinary task offered by Grub, an orc camping east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. To satisfy a hearty desert appetite, Grub sends hungry adventurers south to the dwarven excavation at Bael Modan to gather a batch of plump dig rats for a dubious pot of stew.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An adventurer like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.
Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.
Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.
You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Whack enough dig rats yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... So... Ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.
Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go.
